senses.gloss: (b. h.) [paste, viscous substance,] tasteless matter, insipid, not salted.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 128a:20">Sabb. 128ᵃ</cite> <he>בשר ת׳</he> unsalted (raw) meat, opp. <cite ref="M01552"><he>מליח</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: dependent, child.—Pl. תְּפֵילִין. Y. Shebi. VII, beg. 37ᵇ, v. אֲלוּנְטִית II; [perh. לת׳ for pastes, plasters].—[Tosef. Sot. VI, 8 על התפל ed. Zuck., v. תִּפְלָה.]
